text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, as we stroll through the shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, here we go again. Give me a sec.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oh, Natie, you're here! Are you gonna try your luck again this year?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Of course! You can cry all you want, but I won't comfort you after I snatch away the grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you seem extra fired up. Let's have a clean, fair fight! I won't pull any punches!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's how I like… wait, as opposed to what? Are you usually rigging this thing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Anyways, I'm not the same Nature I was before! I went to the shrine a hundred times this year! I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I have to get myself fired up. This is it—the year I…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Finally rid myself of the dishonorable title of "Third-Prize Collector!"

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Natie has done this raffle every year since we first got to know each other…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: But no matter how many times she tries, she always gets the third-place prize. It became the talk of the town for a time since it was so impressive! All that talk has mostly died down now, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Three, three, three! The number three follows me around everywhere I go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But that ends today. With this beautiful raffle ticket that I purified at the shrine a hundred times over…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll summon all the luck in the world and win the grand priiiiiize! Hot spring vacation, here I come!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Do it with me, Trainer! We're going to break the curse!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I grip the lever with Nice Nature, who looks full of all manner of frustrations and even enmity, and turn the raffle tumbler's lever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What…what did you just…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Natie… You've won. The grand-prize, the coupon for the hot spring vacation… It's all yours!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tra… T-Trainer… I-I-I won the grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And it's for a hot spring! My favorite place! Can you believe it?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh! I mean… ahem. Excuse me, I'm too old to get carried away like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But wow. The gods must've finally decided to show me some sympathy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Anyways, tell everyone about this, okay? Tell them that Nature snatched the grand-prize.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll put it on the front page of the community newspaper too!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: I've got the perfect headline. "Natie Redeems Herself and Sets Off for Hot Spring Vacation Paradise with Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah—wait!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wh-whaaaat?! Me and T-Trainer?! On a hot spring vaca—

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that not what you're doing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Th-that's r-ridiculous! Why would I go to a hot spring with my trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: N-no, Trainer, that's not what I meant! What I was trying to say was…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! You know what?! You take it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I mean, it's not like I wanted to go to the hot spring, anyway. I just wanted to get rid of that stupid title!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Now that I have, I can give the coupon to you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You go enjoy yourself whenever you want to. Really… I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well! I guess I'll get the finest sirloin steak to celebrate my victory before heading home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I decide to hold on to the coupon for now.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yes! We won the first-prize, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad. I seriously could not stand being the "Third-Prize Collector."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What do you think of that, Gramps?!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: All right, you win. That was great, Natie! With this kinda luck, it's gonna be trophy after trophy!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, hold on there…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's not exactly how it works… Being lucky doesn't mean I can win…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, why am I disappointed—
choice_data_list: Nature's going to win because she has what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's right! My apologies!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: I'm happy you have such an amazing trainer, Natie!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's enough of that kind of talk! Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Now that we've got a delicious hamburger steak, let's get back and fire up the grill!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …I'll cook it for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, we enjoy a delicious hamburger steak prepared just the way Nice Nature likes.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hnnng, so close! But I guess it's not that bad.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: At least I avoided the third-prize. Yeah, I'm calling it a win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: At any rate… I never realized how big a bushel was. Aren't you being a bit too generous?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Well, the raffle is the main attraction of this shopping district! We gotta go all out with things like this if we want to go…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: "Viral," was it? Natie, you should take a photo of this and post it on your social mixer too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You mean "social media." It's touching seeing you working so hard to keep up with the times, Gramps.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Trainer, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Can you take a photo for me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I want to capture this mind-boggling amount of carrots, along with me and the old man.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …It's not like I have any influence or anything, but I can at least tell my friends about it.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Natie… you're such a good kid. I still remember when you were just a tot…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You didn't know me when I was a kid, silly. Come on, smile for the camera!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I snap a picture Nice Nature with a big smile, holding a mound of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You've extended your record, unfortunately. I'm sorry, but it is what it is.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Welp, I did it again. I've gotta accept defeat.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm starting to suspect that this is some sort of superpower at this point. Should I donate myself to a lab?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Juuust kidding. It's just a game, right? Thanks for the carrot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Crunch into sweetness galore! They say fresh carrots are the best carrots!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yup, that's the stuff, I'm feeling rejuvenated already! Ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: …She's frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, despite her wishes, Nice Nature once again defends her title of "Third-Prize Collector."

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tissues? I don't even know what to say.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I guess this one is the most practical, which isn't so bad, but…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You even said you went to the shrine a hundred times. I'm kinda sad that I couldn't see a miracle either.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: C-can you not? I kinda feel guilty. But more than anything…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's super embarrassing! Why did I say all those things in the heat of the moment?!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You summoned all the luck in the world…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah! Stop! Forget what I said!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The people of the shopping district tease Nice Nature, wearing her out.
